title: Invertibility of the pasted constant unit along the diagonal
statement: For any commutative ring $A$ and any scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], let $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $W=P\times_SP$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product], and choose either projection $p:W\to P$. Let $\Delta:P\to W$ be the diagonal. In the ordinary etale unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the morphism $\alpha:A_P\to Rp_*R\Delta_*A_P$ obtained by pasting the two constant-object units, exactly projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha of [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-integrals], is invertible. There is no finiteness, torsion, or Noetherian hypothesis.

source.place: Levelwise finite diagonal check, expanded in lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals

proof.text: The composite of the diagonal with either projection is identity. Compose leftDerivedUpperStarComp with the derived upperStarId comparison, the exact identity-derived comparison, and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. These explicitly identify the composite inverse-image functor with identity.

source.place: Levelwise finite diagonal check, expanded in lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals

proof.text: The abstract two-adjunction lemma transports fullness and faithfulness from the identity through this isomorphism, so the composite adjunction unit is invertible. Expand alpha, use naturality of the second unit, and identify it with this composite unit followed by the image of the composite of the two constant-object comparison isomorphisms. All these factors are invertible. The Lean proof uses the Mathlib composite-unit formula and full-faithfulness unit instance. The private generic cached-unit helper expands derivedSingleUnit_eq at abstract categories and applies this same two-adjunction argument before specializing to scheme sheaves; this preserves the construction while avoiding repeated expansion of concrete derived adjunctions.
